```{=html}
<!-- Lakdawala Lab, Emory -->
<section class="lab-section">
  <div class="two-column-layout">
    <div class="content-column">
      <h4>Emory University School of Medicine: Lakdawala Lab</h4>
      <p><strong>Research Scientist, Computer Vision | PI: <a href="https://med.emory.edu/departments/microbiology-immunology/research/lakdawala-lab/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Dr. Seema Lakdawala</a></strong></p>
      <p><em>January 2026 - Present</em></p>
      <ul>
        <li>Pose estimation and identity tracking for dye-marked ferrets under dense occlusion in influenza-transmission studies (<a href="FUN.html">more here</a>).</li>
        <li>Decoupled identity from pose with SLEAP creator Dr. Talmo Pereira: Random Forest HSV classifier with Hungarian matching.</li>
        <li>Confidence- and margin-gated assignment abstains rather than guessing, so occlusion swaps cannot propagate.</li>
        <li>Architected the AWS GPU pipeline (EC2/S3, sleap-nn/PyTorch/CUDA): ~1.5 h per 2 h video, streaming at flat memory.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="image-column">
      <figure style="margin: 0;">
        <video class="autoloop" muted loop playsinline controls preload="metadata"
               style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 380px; object-fit: contain;">
          <source src="videos/sleap-ferret-tracking.mp4" type="video/mp4">
          Your browser does not support the video tag.
        </video>
        <figcaption class="image-caption">Multi-animal pose and identity tracking.</figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
